title: Structured Output Parsers
summary: This module provides various output parsers designed to convert unstructured text generated by Language Models into structured formats like lists or XML. It includes base classes for handling both synchronous and asynchronous streaming outputs.

nodes.label: LLM Raw Text Output
nodes.title: LLM Raw Text Output
nodes.description: Unstructured text output generated directly by a Language Model, requiring further processing.

nodes.label: Base Output Parser
nodes.title: Base Output Parser
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all output parsers, defining the fundamental interface for parsing LLM outputs.

nodes.label: Base List Parser
nodes.title: Base List Output Parser
nodes.description: Abstract base class for parsers that convert LLM output into various list formats.

nodes.label: Base Streaming Parser
nodes.title: Base Transform Output Parser
nodes.description: Provides a base for parsers that can handle streaming LLM output, transforming chunks into a desired format.

nodes.label: Cumulative Streaming Parser
nodes.title: Base Cumulative Transform Output Parser
nodes.description: Extends streaming parsers to accumulate and yield diffs or full parsed outputs from continuous input streams.

nodes.label: Comma-Separated List Parser
nodes.title: Comma-Separated List Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a list of strings, splitting by commas, and handles CSV-like formats.

nodes.label: Numbered List Parser
nodes.title: Numbered List Output Parser
nodes.description: Extracts items from LLM output formatted as a numbered list (e.g., '1. Item A, 2. Item B').

nodes.label: Markdown List Parser
nodes.title: Markdown List Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output to extract items from a Markdown-formatted unordered list (e.g., '- Item A, * Item B').

nodes.label: XML Output Parser
nodes.title: XML Output Parser
nodes.description: Converts LLM-generated XML strings into a structured Python dictionary, supporting streaming and security features.

nodes.label: Structured List Output
nodes.title: Structured List Output
nodes.description: A Python list of strings, extracted and structured from the raw LLM output by a list parser.

nodes.label: Structured XML Output
nodes.title: Structured XML Output
nodes.description: A Python dictionary representing the hierarchical structure of XML data, parsed from LLM output.

groups.label: Base Parsers
groups.title: Core Output Parser Abstractions
groups.description: Fundamental abstract classes that define the interface and common functionalities for all output parsers, including streaming capabilities.

groups.label: Specific Parsers
groups.title: Concrete Output Parser Implementations
groups.description: Concrete implementations of output parsers designed to convert LLM raw text into specific structured formats like various lists or XML.

groups.label: Data Flow
groups.title: Input and Output Data Structures
groups.description: Represents the raw input from Language Models and the structured data outputs produced by the parsers.
